bools.name: dkoFrequencyRare

bools.name: dkoTreasureI
bools.comment: the treasure type - the I of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoDamageByWeapon
bools.comment: the damage per attack - the by weapon type of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoSpecialAttacksSpells
bools.comment: the special attacks - the spells of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoSpecialDefensesSpells
bools.comment: the special defenses - the spells of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoMRStandard
bools.comment: the magic resistance - the standard of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoIntVery
bools.comment: the intelligence - the very of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoAlignmentChaoticGood
bools.comment: the alignment - the chaotic good of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoPsionicNil
bools.comment: the psionic ability - the nil of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoModesNil
bools.comment: the attack and defense modes - the nil of the stat block (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoMermanRelative
bools.comment: the kin - a close relative of the merman and mermaid, virtually identical in appearance (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoFlamingRedHair
bools.comment: the mark - except that it always has flaming red hair (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoDwellUnderWaves
bools.comment: the home - they dwell under the waves and rarely come to the surface (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoServeTheSeaLord
bools.comment: the allegiance - preferring to serve the Sea Lord rather than become involved in the affairs of men (print capture p. 279)

bools.name: dkoKindlyHelpful
bools.comment: the temper - quite kindly and helpful to humans (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoSailorsProtectors
bools.comment: the sailors - they consider them protectors and sometimes make offerings to them, especially during great storms (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoNormallyUnarmed
bools.comment: the arms - ningyo normally do not carry weapons (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoArmedTridentOrSpear
bools.comment: the armed choice - when armed they have either a trident or spear (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoPeacefulNonCombative
bools.comment: the bearing - generally peaceful and non-combative, preferring to avoid a fight whenever possible (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoFightIfForced
bools.comment: the exception - if forced, they fight with whatever weapons are available (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoSpellcastingShukenjaWuJen
bools.comment: the spellcasting - they have the spellcasting abilities of a shukenja and wu jen of a level equal to their hit dice, so a 3 HD ningyo has the spell ability of a 3rd-level shukenja and wu jen (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoNoUnderseaCommunities
bools.comment: the society - they do not form communities under the sea (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoRoamWithCurrents
bools.comment: the roaming - instead they roam with the currents and follow the schools of fish upon which they feed (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoCannotSurviveOutOfWater
bools.comment: the water need - they cannot survive out of water for any length of time (print capture p. 280)

bools.name: dkoSpeakThreeLanguages
bools.comment: the languages - they speak the languages of the Sea Lord, fishes, and the trade language (print capture p. 280)
